ModernFi’s solutions help institutions attract and retain large-value depositors, driving growth and increasing balance sheet stability.

about_short_description.short_description: ModernFi is a deposit network company that provides extended insurance to depositors through program institutions.

product.name: Deposit Network
product.description: A network that enables financial institutions to offer extended deposit insurance, source overnight funding, and sweep excess deposits to manage balance sheets.

product.name: Prospect Finder
product.description: A data product that helps financial institutions identify, research, and acquire new large-value clients and members.

product.name: Term Funding
product.description: Software that enables financial institutions to source cost-effective term funding on demand to manage their balance sheets.

product.name: Sweep Program
product.description: A service that allows financial institutions to sweep excess deposits off their balance sheets into the ModernFi Network to generate income and manage balance sheet size.

product.name: Source Funding On Demand
product.description: A funding solution that provides financial institutions with access to stable, non-collateralized overnight or term funding from other institutions.
